title: {{NAME}} and the Sparkle Valley Quest
moral: When friends work together, every problem can be solved.

pages.content: {{NAME}} was playing in Sparkle Valley. The valley had rainbow flowers and glittery hills. A big friendly dinosaur stomped up the path. The dinosaur had green scales and kind brown eyes. Then a white unicorn galloped out of the trees. The unicorn had a golden horn and a pink mane. Something was wrong in the valley today.

pages.content: The unicorn said her name was Luna. Luna was very upset. "The princess lost her crown," said Luna. "It rolled into the big cave!" {{NAME}} looked at the dark cave on the hill. It was big and dark and deep. His eyes went wide. But he was not afraid. He had two good friends beside him.

pages.content: They all ran into the cave together. Luna lit the cave with her glowing golden horn. The dinosaur sniffed the ground and followed the smell. {{NAME}} spotted a sparkle in the dark. There it was! The golden crown was sitting on a rock. {{NAME}} grabbed it and held it high. Everyone cheered!

pages.content: That evening, the princess made them all a warm strawberry cake. They sat on soft grass under the stars. Luna glowed softly. The dinosaur hummed a happy tune. When friends work together, every problem can be solved. {{NAME}} felt cosy and sleepy. He closed his eyes and smiled. He wondered if Luna knew any more secret caves.
